source.anchor: Original Samplinglib supplement. Compose on filtration prefixes and use a uniform horizon bound for time sections and the sample-first product.
source.original_text:
The scalar process \(b(t,\omega)=c(t,X_t(\omega))\) is strongly progressive. Its time section is integrable for every sample on the specified horizon and it has the indicated product-space \(L^p\) membership.

The state space is pseudometrizable with its Borel measurable structure. The sample measure \(\mu\) is finite and its filtration is indexed by nonnegative time.
The process \(X\) is jointly measurable and strongly progressive. The real coefficient \(c\) on nonnegative time times state is Borel measurable. A finite constant bounds \(|c(t,w)|\) for all \(t\le T\) and all states \(w\).
The horizon \(T\) is nonnegative and \(p\) is any extended nonnegative real exponent.
The symbol \(\ell_T\) denotes Lebesgue time restricted to \([0,T]\).

b(\cdot,\omega)\in L^1(\ell_T)\quad(\forall\omega),\qquad[(\omega,t)\mapsto b(t,\omega)]\in L^p(\mu\otimes\ell_T).

theorem anonymous_target.{u_1,

  {Ω : Type u_1} {S : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace S] [TopologicalSpace.PseudoMetrizableSpace S]
  [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S] {filtration : MeasureTheory.Filtration NNReal inferInstance}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (X : NNReal → Ω → S)
  (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X)) (hProgressive : MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration X)
  (c : NNReal × S → ℝ) (hc : Measurable c) (T : NNReal) (p : ENNReal)
  (hBound : ∃ C, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ (x : S), ‖c (t, x)‖ ≤ C) :
  have b := fun t ω => c (t, X t ω);
  MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive filtration b ∧
    (∀ (ω : Ω),
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => b t ω)
          (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.MemLp (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction b) p
        (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure μ T)

def MeasureTheory.IsStronglyProgressive.{u_1, u_2, u_3} : {Ω : Type u_1} →
  {ι : Type u_2} →
    {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} →
      [inst : Preorder ι] →
        {β : Type u_3} →
          [TopologicalSpace β] → [MeasurableSpace ι] → @MeasureTheory.Filtration Ω ι inst m → (ι → Ω → β) → Prop :=
fun {Ω} {ι} {m} [inst : Preorder ι] {β} [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace β] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace ι] f u =>
  ∀ (i : ι),
    @MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable
      (Prod (@Subtype ι fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) Ω) β inst_1
      (@MeasurableSpace.prod
        (@Subtype ι fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) Ω
        (@Subtype.instMeasurableSpace ι
          (fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x) inst_2)
        (@MeasureTheory.Filtration.seq Ω ι inst m f i))
      fun p =>
      u
        (@Subtype.val ι (fun x => @Membership.mem ι (Set ι) (@Set.instMembership ι) (@Set.Iic ι inst i) x)
          (@Prod.fst (@Set.Elem ι (@Set.Iic ι inst i)) Ω p))
        (@Prod.snd (@Set.Elem ι (@Set.Iic ι inst i)) Ω p)

def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2.processFunction.{u_1} : {Omega : Type u_1} →
  (NNReal → Omega → ℝ) → Omega × NNReal → ℝ :=
fun {Omega} eta z => eta z.2 z.1
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ElementaryItoIntegral.processTimeMeasure.{u_1} : {Omega :
    Type u_1} →
  [inst : MeasurableSpace Omega] → MeasureTheory.Measure Omega → NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure (Omega × NNReal) :=
fun {Omega} [MeasurableSpace Omega] mu T =>
  mu.prod (AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo T)
def AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.TimeMeasure.upTo : NNReal → MeasureTheory.Measure NNReal :=
fun T => MeasureTheory.Measure.comap NNReal.toReal (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc 0 ↑T))

publication_context.current_lean_module:
import AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveL2
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Integral.Prod

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveCoefficientBounds

open Filter MeasureTheory Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped NNReal ENNReal
open ElementaryItoIntegral ProgressiveL2

/-- A jointly measurable scalar coefficient with a uniform state bound on a
finite time interval gives a progressive coefficient with integrable time
sections and finite product-space moments on that interval. -/
theorem bounded_measurable_coefficient_along_progressive_process
    {Ω S : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [TopologicalSpace S]
    [PseudoMetrizableSpace S] [MeasurableSpace S] [BorelSpace S]
    {filtration : Filtration ℝ≥0 (inferInstance : MeasurableSpace Ω)}
    {μ : Measure Ω} [IsFiniteMeasure μ]
    (X : ℝ≥0 → Ω → S) (hX : Measurable (Function.uncurry X))
    (hProgressive : IsStronglyProgressive filtration X)
    (c : ℝ≥0 × S → ℝ) (hc : Measurable c) (T : ℝ≥0) (p : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hBound : ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ≤ T, ∀ x, ‖c (t, x)‖ ≤ C) :
    let b := fun t ω => c (t, X t ω)
    IsStronglyProgressive filtration b ∧
    (∀ ω, Integrable (fun t => b t ω) (TimeMeasure.upTo T)) ∧
    MemLp (processFunction b) p (processTimeMeasure μ T) := by
  intro b
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := hBound
  have htime : ∀ᵐ t ∂TimeMeasure.upTo T, t ≤ T :=
    (TimeMeasure.ae_mem_Ioc_zero_upTo T).mono fun _ ht => ht.2
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro t
    let _ : MeasurableSpace Ω := filtration t
    exact (hc.comp
      ((measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (hProgressive t).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
  · intro ω
    have hm := hc.comp (measurable_id.prodMk
      (hX.comp (measurable_id.prodMk (measurable_const (a := ω)))))
    exact Integrable.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable C
      (htime.mono fun t ht => hC t ht (X t ω))
  · have hXswap : Measurable (fun z : Ω × ℝ≥0 => X z.2 z.1) :=
      hX.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk measurable_fst)
    have hm := hc.comp (measurable_snd.prodMk hXswap)
    change MemLp (processFunction b) p (μ.prod (TimeMeasure.upTo T))
    exact MemLp.of_bound hm.aestronglyMeasurable C
      ((Measure.quasiMeasurePreserving_snd.ae htime).mono fun z hz => hC z.2 hz (X z.2 z.1))

end AutoSamplingTheory.TechnicalLemmas.StochasticProcesses.ProgressiveCoefficientBounds

steps.title: Compose on each restricted filtration product
steps.text: The pair \((t,X_t)\) is measurable on each time prefix for that prefix's sigma-algebra. Real-valued Borel measurability gives strong measurability.
steps.lean:
· intro t
    let _ : MeasurableSpace Ω := filtration t
    exact (hc.comp
      ((measurable_subtype_coe.comp measurable_fst).prodMk (hProgressive t).measurable)).stronglyMeasurable
steps.detail: Use strong progressiveness and measurable composition on the restricted domain.

steps.title: Apply the pointwise bound
steps.text: The finite horizon measure is supported in the specified interval. On the product the same time-coordinate bound holds almost everywhere, and both measures are finite.
